impact: Steady consumer spending supports the broad market; no direct read-through to Clement's holdings.
summary: Walmart's fiscal Q3 adjusted EPS of 65 cents beat the 64-cent estimate and sales rose 5.2% to $188.8B vs about $187.4B expected. Comparable sales ex-fuel rose 2.9%, in line. It raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $2.84-$2.89 (from $2.80-$2.87) and sales growth to 4.9%-5.2% (from 4%-5%). Global e-commerce grew 17% and US e-commerce 23%; shares rose nearly 1% premarket.
title: Walmart beats, raises full-year outlook a third time; e-commerce up 17%
